label: GRAPH_RELATIVE_SOURCE_1, with or without…: SourceExists G says some object has no incoming G.edge…
term: graph-relative source, with or without outgoing effect
definition: SourceExists G says some object has no incoming G.edge, reusing Graph.Source. OutgoingSourceExists additionally gives the SAME object an outgoing edge to a distinct object. Neither endpoint asserts effect-universality, unique first cause, modal necessity, God or an actual concrete grounding root.
note: The analyst minimum and its activity corollary are deliberately weaker endpoints than Rutten's full first cause. Source interpretation of this primitive graph and application to reality remain open.
